'''Tiems''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiems (planet)|Tiems]]<ref name="RASB1">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> in the [[Tiems system/Legends|Tiems system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several thousand [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] prisoners were held in the city. They were liberated by Alliance forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] during the [[Battle of Tiems]]. The city was connected to other settlements by the [[Tiems Road]], and was located near the [[Gopps Forest]] and the [[Blue River]].<ref name="RASB1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The city of Tiems, and the subsequent battle fought near the city, was first mentioned in the [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]], published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]]. In [[2009]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' included a reference to a "Tiems system" in the appendix. This article assumes that the city of Tiems is located on a planet within the Tiems system.
